title: Add a site to this agent
summary: Finds a site's news feed from its address, such as thestranger.com, and adds it to the sources this agent searches.
whenToUse: Use when the person names a site this agent should read or follow.

arguments.name: site
arguments.description: The site's address as the person said it, such as thestranger.com

_note: Phase AV.13: a bare domain in the sentence offers this step the way an https address offers Read a web page.
